body.name: \(\mathsf{Handle}_{\mathrm{cert}}\)
body.def: A support-cluster and simplex-face procedure starting from simultaneous empirical-CDF, multinomial, pre-quantile, Gram, and covariance confidence regions; it conditions on estimable within-cell offset differences, maximizes certified Gaussian loss probabilities over unresolved cross-cell translations and face offsets in \(\Gamma_\eta^{G,R}\), and uses a rate-preserving DKW fallback under a deterministic work budget.
